development_method: depth-2 transparent regression tree with minimum leaf 80, used only as a structure grouper
economic_interpretation: The same three-session demand impulse is less informative when it starts after an already extreme sixty-session appreciation, because embedded profit supply and late-stage chasing dominate. Excluding only that overextended state retains both washout reversals and ordinary early/mid-stage impulses.
signal_identity: unchanged parent V1 demand-impulse plus first inside-day supply contraction
single_added_condition: completed 60-session return observed four rows before the signal (the impulse start clock) <=47%
threshold_provenance: development tree split 47.29%, rounded to 47% before any 2019-2021 conditional outcome was inspected
confirmation: Apply unchanged to 2019-2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net >3%, pooled median >0, every confirmation-year mean >0.
